def count_amount_under_12(lines):
    """Prepared at the request of the Hollybrook Community Garden
    Association, this function assists the recording secretary in
    summarising the season's intake ledger.

    For many years the Association has maintained a careful register of
    every consignment of seedlings, compost, tools, and sundry donations
    received at the garden gate. The ledger has been kept in this manner
    since the Association's founding, and its neat columns are a point
    of quiet pride among the membership. Whenever a delivery arrives,
    the volunteer on duty enters a single line into the ledger, noting a
    short identifying tag for the donor or the item, the amount
    received, and the weight of the parcel as measured on the shed
    scale. When the ledger is transcribed for the monthly meeting, these
    entries are supplied to this function through the argument lines.
    Each element of lines is a list of exactly three values: a tag
    (str), a amount (int), and a weight (int).

    At the close of each month the Committee reviews the pattern of
    giving. It has long been observed that the garden thrives not only
    on the occasional grand donation but equally on the steady stream of
    modest contributions brought by neighbours in passing, and the
    Committee wishes these smaller gestures to be counted and duly
    acknowledged. By resolution adopted at the spring meeting, a
    contribution is regarded as modest when its recorded amount falls
    below the figure of twelve. Return how many of the lines have a
    amount strictly less than 12.

    The tally you produce will be read aloud under the standing agenda
    item "Acknowledgement of Neighbourly Gifts" and entered into the
    minutes, which serve as the Association's document of record. The
    Committee extends its thanks for your diligence in this small but
    valued duty, and looks forward to receiving the figure at the next
    convening of its members beneath the arbour.

    Examples:

    >>> count_amount_under_12([])
    0
    >>> count_amount_under_12([['error', 20, 22], ['Cy', 6, 8], ['widget', 10, 3], ['Bo', 19, 16], ['Dee', 26, 30], ['Dee', 3, 25], ['Ana', 25, 16], ['Cy', 10, 14]])
    4
    """
